## Description {#details}

<p>Typed iterator through <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mdnode">MDNode</a> operands.</p>


<p>An iterator that transforms an <em>MDNode::iterator</em> into an iterator over a particular <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/metadata">Metadata</a> subclass.</p>
